description: Full-height (min-block-size) container that vertically centers a principal element, with optional top and bottom elements. Attribute form: data-layout="cover".

attributes.name: data-layout-min
attributes.description: Minimum block size: 50 / 70 / 80vh, xl = 100dvh, auto = none. One-off: style="--layout-min: 65vh".

attributes.name: data-layout-gap
attributes.description: Gap between the non-centered elements, on the shared size scale.

attributes.name: data-hero-overlay
attributes.description: Cinematic bottom gradient for text legibility over a background image.

childAttributes.name: data-layout-principal
childAttributes.description: The vertically centered principal element. A sole child auto-centers without it.

childAttributes.name: data-layout-cover-top
childAttributes.description: Pin to the top (a <header> child is pinned automatically).

childAttributes.name: data-layout-cover-bottom
childAttributes.description: Pin to the bottom (a <footer> child is pinned automatically).
